page: Microsoft Azure D16plds_v7 is an arm64-based virtual machine instance within the Dpldsv7 series, provisioned via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The virtual machine delivers 16 dedicated vCPUs paired with 32.0 GB of system memory, establishing a lean memory allocation ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. No discrete GPU acceleration hardware is included in this profile.

Integrated local storage is a primary hardware attribute, providing 944 GB of direct-attached NVMe SSD capacity. The instance also supports Premium Storage options for attached persistent disks. The reduced memory ratio relative to standard compute configurations enables high core count density and rapid local disk access without the overhead of unused memory capacity.

The hardware balance makes the D16plds_v7 a qualitatively cost-efficient configuration for parallel tasks requiring dedicated compute threads and fast scratch disks over expansive memory arrays. Appropriate operational workloads include software build runners, continuous integration pipelines, batch data transforms, and distributed container hosts that can utilize native ARM instruction sets.
